The test image shows a mango leaf with small, dark brown/black irregular spots scattered across the surface on a white background. No powdery coating, no sooty black encrustation, no curling/withering. This points toward Anthracnose.

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference Anthracnose image shows a more advanced/yellowed leaf. The test image has a green leaf with multiple small, irregular dark brown spots scattered across - matching the Anthracnose description of "oval or irregular brown to deep brown sunken spots on leaves." The other classes are clearly ruled out: no white powder (Powdery_Mildew), no sooty black coating (Sooty_Mould), no wilting/gum secretion (Die_Back).
